# Flexhub
> Wi‑Fi hotspot controller that turns an old phone or tablet into a cheap wireless shortcut / macro panel — plus trackpad, presenter, signature pad and light annotate. No App Store install for everyday use.

Flexhub is a small USB/Bluetooth HID plug. Everyday control happens in the browser after you join the device Wi‑Fi hotspot named flexhub.

## Positioning
- Portable light tool for non-pro and second-screen setups.
- Pitch: record macros on the Wi‑Fi page, save to the device, replay as shortcut-like actions — Stream Deck–like shortcuts without another dedicated deck.
- Also: light trackpad, wireless presenter, signature pad, multimedia shortcut controller.
- Drawing: light/occasional only (PDF annotate, contract signature, kids doodle, beginner doodle). No pressure — not a Wacom tablet.
- Travel / driver-free: plug Flexhub into the desk PC, lounge with the phone controlling it.
- Works with older devices too (example: first-gen Apple iPad mini).

## Key facts
- Product name: Flexhub
- Shop: https://visualbuild.shop/
- Wi‑Fi hotspot SSID: flexhub
- Wi‑Fi hotspot password: build.me
- Hotspot page: http://flexhub.local/ or http://192.168.4.1/
- Bluetooth device name: flexhub
- Everyday use: no App Store / Play Store app required
- Modes: USB HID into the target (driver-free), or Bluetooth HID while powered from a charger
- Macros: record on the Wi‑Fi hotspot page, save on-device, replay later
- No ASB Agent / MCP / AI automation claims on this product page

## Quotable one-liners
- "Join the flexhub Wi‑Fi, open the browser, and your old phone becomes a wireless shortcut panel — macros included, no app for everyday use."
- "Plug Flexhub into the PC, stay on the sofa with the phone — driver-free portable control."
- "Light trackpad, presenter, signatures and PDF annotate — not a Wacom tablet."
